methods: Read-only Roboflow image URL lookup by exact Train/Valid filename
Read-only Roboflow media_analyze on six original image URLs, one per image
Cross-compare six independently returned AI scene descriptions and previously saved cosine metadata
interpretations: AI visual descriptions, not human visual adjudication and not cryptographic/pixel verification.

reviewed_pairs.valid_description: Outdoor green cattle pasture: four cows, tan cow in foreground facing right, other cattle and tropical vegetation, small rustic shelter, distant hills; centered BINGKENG TV watermark; no people.
reviewed_pairs.train_description: Outdoor green cattle pasture: four cows, tan cow in foreground facing right, other cattle, palm trees and rural shelter, distant hills; centered BINGKENG TV watermark; no people.
visual_cross_image_evidence: same distinctive BINGKENG TV watermark in both individual summaries
both descriptions: same pasture and foreground tan cow facing right
both descriptions: four cattle, palm trees, shelter and distant hills
reviewed_pairs.cautions: Two single-image vision descriptions plus prior cosine are supportive of same source video; do not claim exact pixel duplication or definitive capture/session matching.
reviewed_pairs.vision_method: Roboflow media_analyze on each original image URL separately; AI single-image descriptions compared after the fact

reviewed_pairs.valid_description: Outdoor rural paved road: an adult white cow, tan calf and smaller calf along grassy edge, tropical vegetation and rustic fence; centered BINGKENG TV watermark; no people/vehicles.
reviewed_pairs.train_description: Outdoor rural asphalt road: an adult white cow and three light brown calves along a wooded road edge and rustic wire fence; no person statement made in returned summary.
visual_cross_image_evidence: both descriptions: white adult cow and brown calves on rural paved-road edge
both descriptions: tropical trees and rustic fence
reviewed_pairs.cautions: Counts differ between the individual AI descriptions (Valid approximately 3 cattle, Train approximately 4); do not infer identical content, confirm by direct side-by-side source image review.
reviewed_pairs.vision_method: Roboflow media_analyze on each original image URL separately; AI single-image descriptions compared after the fact

reviewed_pairs.valid_description: Group of approximately five at a stone-paved terrace under red-striped canopy; reflective/UNESCO vests, white hard hat held by one person, decorative masonry and arched background.
reviewed_pairs.train_description: Group of approximately eight to nine on an outdoor roof/terrace near weathered traditional walls; reflective and UN-style vests, masks, ID lanyards, camera and urban view.
visual_cross_image_evidence: both descriptions contain multi-person scenes wearing reflective/UNESCO-style vests
both show traditional masonry but different immediate backgrounds
reviewed_pairs.cautions: No pixel identical claim and no confirmed same-camera session; shared article/media source suggested by filenames, with clear scene-composition differences.
reviewed_pairs.vision_method: Roboflow media_analyze on each original image URL separately; AI single-image descriptions compared after the fact

research_implication: An apparently shared animal-video source can span Train and Valid even for nonworker negative controls. Group-aware validation may be needed for negative-control specificity; do not automatically call animal controls erroneous labels or generalize any leakage count beyond reviewed pairs.
